zh-CN.title: 限时活动返场
items: 限时活动结束满三个月后，空间管理员可申请返场。满六个月后可以直接领取下一期，新一期的任务从头开始。
领取已经拥有的活动奖励时，可兑换为 10 点成长值。

en.title: Activities can return
items: Space administrators can request a rerun after three months or activate the next edition directly after six months. Tasks start fresh in each edition.
Claim rewards you already own to receive 10 growth points each.
